description:
Warren Buffett has compared artificial intelligence to nuclear weapons. A warning that it could change the world in ways humanity may not be ready for.

We take a closer look at why the legendary investor believes artificial intelligence could become one of the most dangerous technologies ever created. From deepfakes and massive financial scams to automated market crashes and widespread job disruption, Buffett fears a future where powerful systems move faster than humans can control them.

But while he’s warning about the risks, he’s also preparing for what comes next. Berkshire Hathaway is sitting on a massive cash pile and quietly positioning itself around the infrastructure powering the AI boom.

Is Buffett seeing the next technological revolution, or the next financial bubble?
And what does his strategy reveal about where the economy could be heading?

description:
Imagine a winter that didn’t last months, or even centuries, but 300 million years.

The winter that lasted 300,000,000 years explores the Huronian Ice Age, the longest and most extreme winter Earth has ever experienced.
Triggered by the rise of oxygen-producing microbes and the breakup of Earth’s earliest supercontinent, this ancient climate disaster may have frozen the planet nearly solid.

Paradoxically, this deep freeze also reshaped life on Earth. It wiped out much of the early biosphere, triggered a massive evolutionary bottleneck, and ultimately helped pave the way for oxygen-breathing life, including humans.

What caused this planet-wide freeze? How did life survive it? And could something like it ever happen again?
